apps.localizedDescription: RouteQuest recommends real-world airline routes to fly, ranked by distance, aircraft rarity, and your own flight history. Track flown routes, filter by vibe (ultra-long-haul, A380, polar routes...), and switch between IATA and ICAO codes. Works fully offline. 100% AI-coded.
